_rule: Grading (user rule 2026-09-14): one admissible experimental value -> pass iff |sim - v| within tolerance of v. More than one -> band [min, max]; pass iff sim lies inside the band or within tolerance of the nearer edge. Tolerances in native units: tg_K +/-50 K absolute; density and K +/-5% / +/-30% of the edge value.
_admissibility: Same homopolymer, bulk and unmodified: no blends, IPNs, plasticizers, crosslinked, substituted, chlorinated, deuterated or copolymer entries.
Phase and stereo matched to the simulated cell: amorphous (or an explicit amorphous extrapolation); tacticity as built (aPS atactic, PLLA L, sPVC syndiotactic).
Tg: the glass transition itself (not a labelled sub-Tg relaxation or softening point); chains above oligomer length (Mn > 1000).
Density: at 293-303 K, or a published equation evaluated at 300 K (value and equation recorded).
K: isothermal (Tait/PVT/compressibility) at or near 300 K; ultrasonic K_S excluded.

Every value traceable to a source row or a read text; DB = db/experimental_db.sqlite table:id; Mark = Mark 2007 Physical Properties of Polymers Handbook; PDH = Polymer Data Handbook 1999; PH4 = Polymer Handbook 4th ed.

_credibility: Band members restricted to tier A (number read with method in the primary source or handbook page) and tier B (handbook value whose method/conditions are recorded). Tier C (handbook value without method or conditions, or an approximate abstract statement) is excluded. Tier D (derived, or an equation extrapolated outside its measured range) is used only where no A/B value exists, and is flagged.
